ja408:1.1: Amb' āham addaṃ vanamantarasmiṃ nīlobhāsaṃ phalinaṃ saṃvirūḷhaṃ, tam addasaṃ phalahetū vibhaggaṃ, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
ja408:2.1: Selaṃ sumaṭṭaṃ naravīraniṭṭhitaṃ nārī yugaṃ dhārayi appasaddaṃ, dutiyañ ca āgamma ahosi saddo, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
ja408:3.1: Dijā dijaṃ kuṇapam āharantaṃ ekaṃ samānaṃ bahukā samecca āhārahetū paripātayiṃsu, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmi.
ja408:4.1: Usabh' āham addaṃ yūthassa majjhe calakkakuṃ vaṇṇabalūpapannaṃ, tam addasaṃ kāmahetū vitunnaṃ, taṃ disvā bhikkhācariyaṃ carāmīti.
ja408:5.1: Karaṇḍu nāma Kaliṅgānaṃ Gandhārānañ ca Naggaji Nimirājā Videhānaṃ Pañcālānañ ca Dummukho, ete raṭṭhāni hitvāna pabbajiṃsu akiñcanā.
ja408:6.1: Sabb' ev' ime devasamā samāgatā aggī yathā pajjalito tath' ev' ime, aham pi eko carissāmi Bhaggavi hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikānīti.
ja408:7.1: Ayam eva kālo, na hi añño atthi, anusāsitā me na bhaveyya pacchā, aham pi ekā carissāmi bhaggava sakuṇī va muttā purisassa hatthā ti
ja408:8.1: Āmaṃ pakkañ ca jānanti atho loṇaṃ aloṇikaṃ, tam ahaṃ disvā pabbajiṃ, car' eva tvaṃ carām' ahan ti.
